ai_summary: Iris Clothings Limited reported a robust Q1 FY27, with 53% year-on-year growth in net profit and EBITDA, achieving a 17.12% EBITDA margin, driven by expanding distribution, new product launches, and a strategic push into D2C and quick commerce. A material development is the approved 51% acquisition of Infinia, diversifying the company into the athleisure segment via internal accruals, which is expected to drive 30-35% consolidated growth. However, Infinia's currently lower operating margins (7-8%) represent a potential integration and profitability challenge, despite management's confidence in maintaining and improving overall consolidated margins.
